summary: All six dimensions pass. The page aligns with its plan brief, covers all four assigned subsections without scope drift, cites only the two assigned source URLs plus one permitted internal path, maintains clear and readable prose, avoids significant repetition, and correctly omits an FAQ section. Each subsection addresses its assigned workflow role, input, decision, record, and exception elements. The illustrative manufacturer example appears in all four subsections, is correctly labeled as hypothetical, and is never presented as a measured customer result. Citations to the ICC processes page and ISO APG source are accurate and support their sentences. Vendor descriptions are consistently distinguished from verified installed behavior throughout.
